channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
  • Luminos.AI Legal Engineering Fellowship (Fall 2026)
    https://www.luminos.ai/jobs/luminos-ai-fellowship-program-fall-2026
    Luminos.AI · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 35 per hour, part-time. No application fee.
  • IIE Scholar Rescue Fund (IIE-SRF) Fellowship for Threatened and Displaced Scholars
    https://www.iie.org/programs/scholar-rescue-fund/for-scholars/
    Institute of International Education (IIE), Scholar Rescue Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Fellowship of up to USD 30,000 for one year, paid towards a temporary academic position at a host institution; in most cases renewable for a second and final year. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kennan Institute Digital Fellowship 2026-2027
    https://www.kennaninstitute.org/digital-fellowship
    Kennan Institute, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars (supported by the Lounsbery Foundation and the U.S. Russia Foundation) · deadline Closed 14 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000 monthly stipend for the six-month programme, plus mentorship from the Kennan community of experts, six virtual webinars tailored to the cohort, and inclusion in the Kennan alumni network of over 4,500 people. Travel and visa costs are explicitly not covered. No application fee.
  • AIAF Fellowship, Autumn 2026
    https://www.aialignmentfoundation.org/fellowship
    AI Alignment Foundation · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · USD 12,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus a compute budget. Travel covered for in-person Demo Day attendance. No application fee.
  • Good Life Residents Program: AI and Finance
    https://rooseveltinstitute.org/careers/good-life-resident-program/
    Roosevelt Institute, in partnership with Data & Society · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,000 stipend, plus travel and accommodation for the culminating event if needed. No application fee.

    https://www.durham.ac.uk/sir-harry-evans-memorial-fund/global-fellowship/

    https://www2.fundsforngos.org/innovation/call-for-applications-crp-research-fellowship-programme/

    https://us.boell.org/en/2026/05/12/global-majority-ai-fellowship
